sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: You're rarely surprised or bothered by the occasional setback. Today, however, you should put a firm hand on any project you undertake. This isn't the time for a relaxed attitude, especially where money is concerned. If you take a systematic approach, you will have the double benefit of conserving both energy and assets.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Permit yourself to linger in softness before getting out of bed, dearest Taurus. An imaginative energy surrounds you this morning, as the Cancer Moon and Neptune align. Leaning into these dreamy vibes can unlock new visions, but don't be tempted to shirk your responsibilities. Professional disagreements could complicate your ability to move up or secure major projects while Luna enters unbalanced aspects with the Sun and Pluto. Let others' arguments sink in, and take time to craft a strong rebuttal. If you must act quickly, lean into compromise. Mental blocks might signal a need for rest when Luna squares Saturn later today.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Don't self medicate as chances of drug dependency may increase. Due to a function being organized at home, you will have to spend a lot of money today. This can negatively affect your financial condition. Your involvement in others affairs should be avoided today. Wrong communication or a message might make your day dull. You can suddenly plan to take off from work today and spend time with your family. Rudeness of your spouse might keep you upset throughout the day.

readings.text: Emotional fluctuations are on the cards today. The mood swings are not likely to help you in decision making. You may lose out some important meetings or workshop. There may be a delay in major decision making. Your determination will plunge as the day progresses, predicts Ganesha.

Today won't be your finest hour when it comes to work so take the day off if you can. If you do find yourself having to work, make the most of it by tackling projects that require an extra amount of force, finesse, and power. You will have these qualities in excess.
